about: The Velvet Tin's court (for-review/design/map-of-ashmarket.md, place 9): three trailers along the north side of a walled court, come into by the gate in its south wall from Tin Lane. Read by Tools/build_town_level.py (GUT_TOWN_LIST=$PWD/Tools/town_velvet_tin.json Tools/build_town_level.sh). Places are in the map's own metres (x east, y north). BUILT AS FAR AS THE COURT: nobody goes into the trailers, and what the house sells is not shown or written. The trailer, the wall of car doors and the curtained gate were made in Mixar for this place (ArtSource/mixar/tin_*). Nothing lights it that is not seen to burn.
name: The Velvet Tin
errand: Madam Corazon's house: three trailers and a court.
Madam Corazon, at the middle trailer's door.
Captain Voss of the Wardens, at the back table in the corner, when there is work.
The curtain in the south wall: Tin Lane, and back to Block Square.

lines.words: Corazon. Everybody is corazon here, so you may as well start. The house is full tonight, and nobody inside it is here because of a collar. That is the whole of what I sell.

answers.words: Who is at the back table?

lines.words: The Captain. Twenty litres a week of mine goes across that table, and I smile when it goes. If the Captain has work for you, take it at the table and do it somewhere else.

people.name: Captain Voss
people.prompt: Talk to Captain Voss, at the back table

lines.words: The Toll. That is what they call me past the gate, and they are right to. Everything on that wall has a price, and I know all of them. You have nothing I am selling tonight.

doors.prompt: Out through the curtain, to Block Square

doors.shut: Car seats along one wall, and a curtain. "Full tonight," somebody says from behind it.
Bolted from inside. There is music behind it, played low on something with one string missing.
